observation.command: cd /workspace && python3 -m http.server 8099 --directory build >/tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8099/index.html; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8099/en/index.html; curl -s http://localhost:8099/de/index.html | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' | head -1; kill %1 2>/dev/null
